thread:
Maya: Quick heads-up — I need approvals to merge a small cross-repo dep chain before tomorrow's canary. PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/api/pull/123, https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/456, https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/789, https://github.com/redwood-inference/helm-charts/pull/101
Arjun: Which order do they need to go in?
Maya: Order is API -> SDK -> Console -> Helm -> runtime rollout. API introduces a minor auth header shape change; SDK bumps client and keeps a compat shim; console updates client usage; helm flips a runtime flag.
Sarah: Can you paste the exact schema change? makes it faster to eyeball the SDK diff.
Maya: sure — header used to be `Authorization: Bearer <string>`; new shape is an object: `HeaderAuth { token: string, meta: map<string,string> }`. API PR adds a shim that accepts either string or object and normalizes to object. SDK needs to handle both for a short window.
Arjun: I'll pick up the API review now.
Maya: thanks — API PR 123 has unit tests and a note in the changelog about the compat window.
deploy-bot: CI: api#123 — all checks passed :white_check_mark:
Sarah: I can review SDK after lunch (around 13:00 PT). If you add an explicit unit test that sends the old string header and asserts normalization it speeds my review.
Maya: added test to sdk#456 (`test_auth_header_compat`) and pushed. Also left a comment showing the exact deserialization snippet.
deploy-bot: CI: sdk#456 — buildkite failed on `client/reconnect_test` (flaky) :x:
Arjun: lemme rerun the SDK build.
Sarah: rerun queued, restarting now :eyes:
deploy-bot: CI: sdk#456 — rebuild passed :white_check_mark:
Sarah: quick pass done. Two small nits in comments, but main logic + compat test LGTM. Approving now. :thumbsup:
Lee: Console PR 789 is blocked on the SDK version bump in package.json. I can rebase once sdk#456 merges.
Maya: perfect — once api#123 and sdk#456 are merged, console can be a fast follow. Helm change is just adding `enable_new_auth: false` by default; ops wants helm updated after console roll.
Arjun: API merged and released (v0.18.2) — changelog + compat note included.
Maya: great, thanks Arjun.
Sarah: SDK merged and published to canary tag `sdk@0.9.0-canary` — console can test against that tag.
Lee: rebase incoming, will smoke test console against canary this afternoon and post results.
Maya: thank you all. Plan: merge order done, helm PR will wait until console smoke passes, then we'll flip `enable_new_auth` in staging, run runtime integration tests, and then schedule rollout.
Arjun: ping me if any rollout needs quick rollback hooks; I can add temporary feature-flag guard.
Sarah: noted. If console smoke is green I'll add a short note in the release playbook for the oncall.
Maya: ETA for full merge+helm flip ~16:30 PT today. Thanks everyone :heart:
Lee: copying in ops later if smoke passes.
Maya: will post final status here after helm update.
